purpose: Test environment-dependent multigenerational retention, regulatory dormancy, duplication and loss of material neural grammar without hand-tuning neural benefit.

primary_gate.stable_shrinkage: At least 2/3 stable replicates finish with mean active grammar modules <= 1.5.
primary_gate.complex_retention: At least one of periodic/long_delay finishes with mean organ frequency >= 0.6 and mean active grammar modules >= 2.5 in at least 2/3 replicates.
primary_gate.environment_dependence: The retained complex environment exceeds stable final mean active-module count by >= 1.0.
primary_gate.causal_knockout: For the retained environment's best evolved genotype, knockout reduces margin AUC in >= 4/6 holdout pairs.
primary_gate.causal_reintroduction: Full grammar reintroduction improves over knockout in >= 4/6 holdout pairs.
primary_gate.material: All body assays finite and |material residual| < 3e-5.

controls: HGT absent in accelerated lineage assay
interpretation_rule: A negative gate is a valid scientific result. Do not tune post-hoc thresholds or seeds to force neural retention.
